test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, E, F, P, Q and R, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit between A and E. Only P sits to the right of Q. Only one person sits between E and Q. R sits at some place to the right of B but at some place to the left of F. Who sits third from the right end of the row?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, E, F, P, Q and R, are sitting in a row, facing north. 

1) Only P sits to the right of Q.

2) Only one person sits between E and Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2324a2eeec5be9e942e6f625063c07984452bb7aaadcc90fef44161bce92eb54.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7a6a21a930b9fb92a093ed3c5c68bc385565c4571df9233f1eb7d42c4f352a.png] 

3) Only two people sit between A and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d89efec43bb8835058f02054ce017833a193a7695e3e0b77144bcc008737db56.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78200a9c0e0d812f9ef6d39f7cb9376b6c524f69d0c4f01e23cf44c863783efb.png] 

4) R sits at some place to the right of B but at some place to the left of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b011bad21c1513cc2eef8ee6ee8510480cd37793a54b838312fbdff8f1ef8165.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff9f733cd99fc101eef8f098afe44d80cf91f39627ff6d17496cc0d66432db58.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, F sits third from the right end of the row.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
